main_body: bare gothic tree trunk and branches
evidence: The bare tree is drawn as a flat front silhouette: the top edge at row 0 is abruptly clipped at the canvas border, the base roots (rows 60-62) are a flat horizontal bar rather than a 3D radiating root cluster seen from above, and the branch fork at row 34 has a flat horizontal seam line across the trunk.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees (which have rich 6-step shading, sculpted 3D root bases, and organic silhouettes), the candidate is clipped flat across the top at row 0, has a flat horizontal bar for roots at the bottom, and uses a heavy near-black outline around skinny 2-3px branches.
